verdict.rationale: FFmpeg ships its own official C libraries (libavformat, libavfilter, libavdevice) with nightly Doxygen API documentation and coding examples, so developers can build directly against first-party libraries. Community users note the libav API docs and examples are sparse or outdated, and that the C API makes invalid states easy to represent. Missing for 10: official SDKs or bindings beyond the C libraries (e.g. Python/JS), comprehensive and current API guides and tutorials, AI-friendly machine-readable docs (llms.txt and markdown docs return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: libavformat implements streaming protocols, container formats and basic I/O access.
libavfilter provides means to alter decoded audio and video through a directed graph of connected filters.
Coding examples are available in the doc/examples directory.
